response.sql:
WITH site_avg AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat,
         AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem,
         AVG(p.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_site_memusagegb,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_avg
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per processing row by casting procgpu to numeric before dividing, so integer truncation is avoided. Rows with NULL or zero proccpu are excluded from the ratio by NULLIF and AVG ignoring NULLs.
Rows with a NULL memusagegb are excluded by the >= 60.8 filter. A site whose entrystat is NULL forms its own group, which is kept in the output rather than dropped.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is taken from the per-site averages instead: for each site and access status, divide the average procgpu by the average proccpu, then average those site-level ratios across each access status.
alternatives.sql:
WITH site_avg AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat,
         AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem,
         AVG(p.procgpu)::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(p.proccpu), 0) AS ratio_of_avgs
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_site_memusagegb,
       AVG(ratio_of_avgs) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_avg
GROUP BY entrystat;
